messages.author: 5d074889c2204101
messages.subject: "annotate" DMRs with transposable elements?
parts:
Dear group,
I could calculate my DMRs between groups of individuals and I also have a full list of transposable elements with physical position. I wanted if there was a function that could help to figure whether CG-CHG-CHH DMRs overlap with TEs or not.
Thanks so much for any suggestion!
Jonathan

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] "annotate" DMRs with transposable elements?
parts:
Hi Jonathan
You should be able to use annotate.WithFeature function after you have TEs as GRanges object. I assume you have DMRs from different contexts in different objects.

Best
Altuna

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] "annotate" DMRs with transposable elements?
parts:
Hi Jonathan,
methylKit doesn't have a function for that but it is pretty easy to get that using findOverlaps() from GenomicRanges package. It returns the indexes of overlapping target and query sets. Using those indexes you can figure out which DMR overlaps with which TE, we are using the same function in the background but not returning the associated features with DMCs/DMRs. it is a long standing request, I didn't have time to implement.

Best,
Altuna
